note: The bio's only scripture is the prayer-answered callout's "Fear thou not, I will help thee" (KJV Isa 41:13 'Fear not; I will help thee', echoing 41:10 'Fear thou not'). Rendered as Kulish Isa 41:13b verbatim — «Не лякайся, я помагаю тобі!» — fetched byte-for-byte from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/ukr_pan/usfm/isa.usfm); only the first letter is capitalised. Same verse, same wording, in FAQ item 9.
No Book C:V citations in the English bio or FAQ; every other quotation is the subject's own words.
